The '''Extorin Minor system''' was located in [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Extorin sector/Legends|Extorin sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Extorin Minor skirmishes]], a conflict fought at some point<ref name="Gamer8">{{GamerCite|8|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Priapulin}}</ref> by [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{GamerCite|8|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Priapulin}} indicates the [[Extorin Minor skirmishes]] occurred at some point prior to the events of ''[[Rogue Planet]]'', which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Extorin Minor [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square J-15.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
